Central Parkway did not exist in 1922; at the expected point a wide (~220 px) unlabelled curved strip between a blue band (west, from 3380,225) and a pink band (east, from 3595,228) runs SSE from the top street. It is probably the canal bed / right of way later used for Central Parkway, which by the rules may not count as a street. Top street ('AVENUE', south block line y~225) has its north side cut off by the page edge (~y 50), so the y is estimated from the label line.
